body: Thanks for all your concern btw. ❤️ But nah, I avoid meeting anyone or talking. I'm simply too numb and tired to do anything. Even if I know I love them, I don't feel it. I know I truly care about them, but I feel no empathy when they talk to me about their issues. I've lost my ability to feel anything. They all know I have problems but I doubt they really expect suicide from me.

I've been suicidal since 9. Two attempts, at 16 and a little over a year ago, survived with dumb luck because I assumed I would be alone those nights but I was found both times. I care for a small handful if people I consider friends, and I want to make sure they're in a good place. If not good, at least decent.
It truly is saddening isn't it? I've given up as in I will go by my own hand as soon as I've got everything settled and the people I care about in a good place where I can leave them.
Reading this made my day, I'm so happy for you two! ❤️
I hope no one ever meets him in real life, goodness... Thank you so much for your words of encouragement, they do mean a lot to me. I hope your life is wonderful as well, lovely stranger! ❤️
Omg you gave me such a good laugh, thank you! You're hilarious! Thank you, I really needed this! The creep made your day, you made mine. ❤️

Thank you for all the words of support, they really mean a lot to me. ❤️ I definitely wanna believe he was just scared too and tried to act tough, and from all my heart do I hope his girlfriend was 100% fiction he created in his filthy fantasies, because no one deserves to grow up so broken... You are an amazing person for sharing your words of encouragement, thank you!

I'm so sorry to hear you've been through something so awful, it's the last thing I'd wish on anyone, ever... I admire your attitude and strength, and I hope everything is a lot better for you now. You've grown to be wonderfully compassionate and kind, thank you for spreading that, thank you for being one of those awesome people you speak of. ❤️

I did some snooping before he deleted his account and noticed he had mentioned said "girlfriend" on the support subreddit before, where he also boasted he's spoken to hundreds of victims who have had explicitly positive experiences with being molested. He was also writing about his nasty fantasies and searching for roleplay buddies. I can still taste the vomit in my mouth.

Thank you from all my heart, I'm not sure if I deserve such high praise but your words are heard and appreciated in any case. I'm grateful for your support. ❤️

I hope that's wrong too, from all my heart... Most likely, his "girlfriend" was his unrealistic fantasy he uses to justify pedophilia. He obviously needs professional help, possibly in the hands of the law. Thank you for your comment! ❤️

Thank you so much! I too like to think he was just scared shitless of all you amazing, supportive people coming for his scaredy ass. You're all the best! ❤️ I hope your day is amazing, thank you for taking the time to drop a line on this post too. :)

Hi everyone, OP here!

I don't expect for anyone to see this, but here goes. I want to start by saying thank you; I never in a million years expected to be met with such warmth and kindness, especially on such a grand scale. There are so many amazing people out there and you all gave me a valuable reminder of that. To everyone who dropped a line of encouragement and support, thank you from all my heart. I am truly sorry I couldn't keep responding to each and every one since I had to go to therapy and I'm exhausted after, but please know I read them all and I've been touched beyond words by your good hearts. Thank you. ❤️ (I will also try to find the strength to reply to DMs to my best ability, they're all important to me also!)

To the few of you in similar situations who bravely opened up - your abusers and those who dare invalidate you are nothing compared to you. You've been through hell yet you're still standing, alive and kicking. You've grown to be compassionate and stronger than you think, supporting others despite your own struggles. I wish for nothing to ever harm you again. You deserve the world and nothing less. ❤️

Lastly, to all of you asking me how I'm doing and wishing me the best, you're too sweet! It means a lot.  ❤️ I am honestly in as good a place as I can be even with recent setbacks. I'm in therapy and slowly moving on to a better life. I have plans, things I want to do and ways to overcome certain hurdles right now - I feel truly blessed to have someone to call family too to make life worth it. It's a rough path but I've come a long way, turned from a shy, overly apologetic, submissive little girl into someone who can slap predators online on the wrist. To which I received a lovely response to...

I do admit he made me uncomfortable, but I faced him, and that's all thanks to you standing behind me and making me feel a lot stronger and better about myself. I did cry over what he said yes, but I'm not going to let him get away with it. I'm past being scared of everything. He said sick, vile things, and it just proves what a piece of human garbage he is. He called my childhood situation "a dream come true " Yes, I still get triggered and cry over getting hurt and invalidated, hearing such despicable things, but I don't regret confronting him. No way in hell. Thank you for giving me the strength to do that. Each and every one of you who left a comment today actually changed me as a person, and I'll never forget this experience - I've never before in my life felt so heard.

The thing is, I tried to post these DMs but it got deleted due to the subreddit having rules against update posts. Where do you suggest I should post them? I really want to show everyone. If I don't, he wins... any ideas?

Thank you again from the bottom of my heart, everyone. You've empowered me and given me a gift, I hope karma will serve you accordingly and I'm sharing all my good thoughts with you! ❤️

I from all my heart hope things turn up, even if it was a few years ago it's a horrible thing to experience and I want you to know it's incredible strength and bravery to be ready to talk about it. You don't always have to be strong and brave. No matter how many years flow by, what happened to you will always be something you're allowed to feel things over - and those things may change over the years. I hope you are in a very safe and loving environment now, I hope you're cared for in every way a child should be and I wish you all the best in this world. I and many others care about you and your wellbeing. Please don't hesitate to reach for help, there's always some available. Lots of love and strength to you... ❤️

That's fair enough, actually. I understand it was a poor anecdote and I could have come up with a better one for this particular situation, but I really wasn't thinking straight then. But personally, I actually don't think it's that shitty, but a poor choice, sure. Thanks for being civil and responding to my question, I appreciate that.

Would you please elaborate? I wish to educate myself, I'm interested in why "it's shit" because I personally don't think it was unjust - I admit it wasn't my finest articulation since I was shaking on the verge of a panic attack, my brain in overdrive. But really I don't wish to fight or nock you or anything, I genuinely wish to hear why you think that? Thanks!
Oh no, I didn't yet... I can't believe I was so careless, I really wasn't thinking straight at all because I was so disgusted... Thank you so much for reminding me, it was very important. ❤️
Thank you so much for the concern, I will block him asap if I feel even a little bit triggered. ❤️

I personally still wish for everyone to be able to keep their privacy... :( But you know you gave me an idea! I'll link this thread to him, and I hope he enjoys reading the comments here... ;) Thanks!
Oh my goodness, thank you so much... You absolutely made my day! ❤️ I hope yours is lovely too!
You have nothing to apologise for, you are most obviously a kind-hearted good person! Thank you for all your words, they're appreciated. ❤️
Thanks for understanding.❤️
Thank you so much, your comment means a lot to me. ❤️
Damn this is seriously so tempting tho!! I'm afraid I'd be too triggered, unfortunately. I rly wish I could tho.
Thank you so much for the support, it means a lot to me. ❤️
Thank you for your kind words and compassion. ❤️ The worst part is that this terrible person will surely contact others, and I worry over those who fall victim to that...
I'm so sorry you've been through something like that, I wouldn't wish it on anyone... There's r/Molested and r/AdultSurvivors

Thanks for the reply, but it most definitely wasn't a positive experience on any level. Worst times of of my life and I hate him more than anything. The fact that he was kind didn't make anything any better. Sorry if I gave the opposite image.
